articles.title: ‘We built this land’: descendants of enslaved people are reclaiming their history across South Africa’s vineyards
articles.summary: Slavery was integral to the country’s wine industry. articles.title: Neville Fay obituary
articles.summary: My friend Neville Fay, who has died aged 78, set up the reforestation charity Tree Aid in 1987 and then went on to reshape understanding of ancient trees and the soil. articles.title: Paddy Donnelly obituary
articles.summary: My husband, Paddy Donnelly, who has died aged 70, was a South African who moved in the early 1980s to London. There he worked for the International Defence and Aid Fund for Southern Africa (IDAF), which funded the legal costs of people tried or imprisoned for anti-apartheid activity.
